node_contract.stable_id_rule: Canonical H0C entity IDs are reused; reified IDs are deterministic projections of canonical fact IDs.

edge_contract.traceability_rule: Every edge must resolve to H0C fact IDs and Evidence IDs or explicit source provenance.
edge_contract.multi_edge_rule: Independent edge types may share endpoints; duplicate same-type semantic edges with the same fact set are invalid.

projection_views.filter: All materialized HG0 edges; preserve candidate/unknown metadata.
review_status == reviewed; this is not a claim that omitted edges are negative.
Bounded/one-sided interval overlap only; unknown and relative-only facts are separate.

temporal_contract.interval_semantics: Inclusive potential-overlap: a bounded edge is returned when its interval intersects the requested interval.
temporal_contract.one_sided_semantics: A lower/upper bound is returned as potentially active when it does not exclude the requested interval.
temporal_contract.unknown_semantics: Unknown and relative-only facts are excluded from strict slices and reported separately; include_unknown may expose them as uncertain context.
temporal_contract.temporal_leakage_rule: A pre-cutoff projection may include only facts whose known end is at or before the cutoff, plus an explicit uncertain bucket; future or unknown facts must not be used as observed features.
temporal_contract.no_exactness_upgrade: Overlap never upgrades approximate, event-bounded, phase-only, relative, or unknown evidence to an exact date.

missingness_contract.required_behavior: Future experiments must carry observed-positive, candidate, unknown, conflicted, and explicit-negative states separately; HG0 generates no negative samples.

research_question_readiness.question: heterogeneous structure representation
research_question_readiness.reason: The combined graph is connected enough for deterministic heterogeneous pilot projections, while layer sparsity and source selection bias remain material.

research_question_readiness.question: constrained link-prediction pilot
research_question_readiness.reason: Family/service layers are sparse and missing edges are unknown rather than negative; use reviewed-only, layer-specific evaluation.

research_question_readiness.question: temporal representation pilot
research_question_readiness.reason: The layer is usable for targeted, evidence-filtered pilots but lacks broad coverage for corpus-level historical inference.

research_question_readiness.question: political-faction discovery
research_question_readiness.reason: No sourced faction ontology exists and service/political coverage is sparse; topology must not invent factions.

research_question_readiness.question: event prediction
research_question_readiness.reason: Event and temporal coverage are too sparse and the published Story scope is selected.

research_question_readiness.question: historical-importance ranking
research_question_readiness.reason: Degree and corpus visibility are selection-biased and are not historical importance labels.

policy: HG0 defines a framework-neutral export contract; ML0 chooses models only after the sufficiency audit and without rewriting canonical facts.
